mentions.name: dmcn.dev
mentions.description: An email service built so recipients can be sure who a message is from, with the recipient deciding whether to trust it. It takes a different approach from existing fixes like filtering, privacy extensions, walled gardens, and throwaway addresses.
mentions.problem: Uncertainty about who an email is really from; existing solutions (filtering, privacy extensions, walled gardens, throwaway email addresses) solve the problem from the wrong end.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://dmcn.dev - an email where you can be sure who it's from. And you get to decide whether to trust it.
